claim: A game that draws random numbers from a byte at an address made of R can read any byte of memory, so a hook must hand it the original's R and no patched byte may sit at such an address.

evidence.text: Random routine 0xBBF3 reads address A*257 (A = R XOR last byte); the first design passed every picture check and failed only the whole-state comparison, 906 steps in.
